column1: # Trash pickup calendar. One row per kind of trash.
# name          what the row is about
# anchor_date  a date on that weekday that IS a pickup; it fixes the phase of
#              the every_n_weeks cycle. Changing it shifts the whole cycle.
# These days are a plausible monday-to-friday spread
# real calendar: edit them to match. Run `make list` afterwards to check.
#   - weekday must be the day the truck actually comes for that bin.
#   - anchor_date must fall on that same weekday and must be a real pickup.
#     It is only the phase marker for every_n_weeks

column2: pick an anchor matching your municipality's first
then the alternating weeks follow automatically.
